notes: Recovery update for the multi-wrap Batch Split after v1.0.11 could fail to install when the expected v1.0.10 loader marker was absent. v1.0.12 no longer requires that marker: it detects the actual batch-split functions present in the installed Library, adds the safe image loader only when missing, then replaces the batch splitter with persistent per-cover control state. The repair was tested against both a source with no v1.0.10 helper and a source where that helper already exists, including real PNG loading and visible WinForms paint-event processing.
